_william.pearson_: Nobody asked Oskar Pearson why he came. Nobody in S-F10 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Oskar Pearson was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F10 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Oskar Pearson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Oskar Pearson found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Oskar Pearson fired at a movement across the wire at S-F10. The man went down: Norbert Fransinlak, grazed.

Oskar Pearson has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F10 with the rations. Oskar Pearson ate while listening to the revised orders.
Dawn watch. Oskar Pearson put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Isidor Acquillae, badly wounded.
The parcel for Oskar Pearson contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Oskar Pearson tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Oskar Pearson aimed a step ahead and fired: Bastian "Owl" Hanka, grazed.
flumpus.wumpus: Day 8: Silas Wumpus reached R-S14 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Silas Wumpus went down at Saint-Ash crossroads and did not get up. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Silas Wumpus reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Silas Wumpus recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through.
mixtapethepyromancer: The quartermaster asked Yann Mixtapethepy to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
superb.ryan: On the way to R-R9, Anselm Ryan tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
valiantlyvaliancy: Nobody saw Otto Valiantlyval arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F6, and a quiet sniper under it.

Otto Valiantlyval pulled Lucien Raphoto out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither of them has mentioned it since. Both of them remember. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Otto Valiantlyval could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Otto Valiantlyval noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.

A clear shot from S-F6. Otto Valiantlyval badly wounded Yann Jimmysparrow and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

The dugout roof dripped into Otto Valiantlyval's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Otto Valiantlyval kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Otto Valiantlyval spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Valiantlyval had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dietrich Wolfmananton crossed it, Otto Valiantlyval fired. Dietrich Wolfmananton was grazed. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Valiantlyval moved to a new hide at S-F6 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Dietrich Wolfmananton, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Valiantlyval mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.
wiwiwib3: Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib arrived with the Day 4 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
A parcel from home held a comb. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.

A clear shot from S-F19. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib grazed Severin Guy and slid back down below the parapet. The guns found S-F19. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The beds were full. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
The medics would not give up on Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F19 today.
Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib kept Arno Dick awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Whistle could have walked there blind.
Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
